R. Q. 2 تَجَلْجَلَ It was, or became, in a state of motion; or was put in motion. (K.) ―
-b2- It was, or became, agitated in the mind. (K, * TA.) ―
-b3- He sank into the ground. (S, K.) It sank, or became depressed; syn. تَضَعْضَعَ. (K.) One says, تَجَلْجَلَتْ قَوَاعِدُ البَيْتِ The foundations of the house sank, or became depressed; syn. تَضَعْضَعَتْ. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
